_contract: Entry shape per NOTATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §2. Classification exists from pass 1; unknown THROWS with diagnostics, never a silent bucket. New classes are decisions with a journal line. All v0 entries are status:proposed until the composer blesses them against real material.
